provenance.about: The seven experiments that would confirm or kill the Corerope design, cheapest decisive ones first, each with what it tests, its pass bar and what follows if it fails.

experiments.experiment: Post-layout energy of a 1024 x 1024 wired ternary tile with shared sums, driven by real activation traces, in a 5nm-class flow
experiments.pass_bar: At most 0.15 pJ including wiring and leakage
experiments.if_it_fails: Above 0.5 pJ, wired silicon is only a speed play, as Taalas's cost figures suggest; drop to stored-weight ASICs

experiments.experiment: Hard-task share: run a frontier agentic and reasoning suite through 8 to 15B models with retrieval, then 60B models
experiments.pass_bar: Tier A solves at least 90%; fewer than 0.1% need more than Tier B
experiments.if_it_fails: The two-tier fleet caps at ~20 to 50x; redesign Tier B larger

experiments.experiment: Inference-priced allocation law: cores of 0.5 to 3B with memory tiers 0 to 100x their size
experiments.tests: Invention 1, and where Engram's U-curve moves when memory is priced at its inference cost
experiments.pass_bar: A 3B core plus memory matches a model with 3x its active compute on knowledge, within 2 points on math and code
experiments.if_it_fails: Knowledge and reasoning do not separate; the core must grow, and the central case drifts toward the pessimistic one

experiments.experiment: Native ternary training at 3 to 8B with dReLU-style activation sparsity
experiments.tests: Event-driven gain and the precision penalty
experiments.pass_bar: Within 1.5% loss of FP8 at equal compute, at least 70% zero activations, under 1.2x longer reasoning
experiments.if_it_fails: Fall back to 2 to 3-bit wired weights at ~2x the gates

experiments.experiment: Freeze regret: freeze a 1 to 3B core, update only memory and adapters over 12 months of time-sliced data
experiments.pass_bar: Under 1 point behind a retrained model at 12 months
experiments.if_it_fails: Chip life shortens and NRE per token rises in proportion

experiments.experiment: Joule-priced RL on an open reasoning model, scored per solved task
experiments.pass_bar: At least 2x fewer tokens per solved task at 1 point or less
experiments.if_it_fails: Tokens per task becomes the pessimistic 1.5x inflation

experiments.experiment: Via-programmed fabric: foundry quote and a routing study for choosing 1 of ~40 sum wires per input with one via layer
experiments.if_it_fails: NRE returns to ~$40M; dollars fall back to ~90x per task
